description: Want to build trust fast—without sounding salesy? Stop pitching. Start telling better stories. There are three stories that create connection, proof, and authority. I call it the Storytelling Flywheel. Story #1: Your origin. Why you started. What frustrated you. What pushed you to figure it out. Not impressive. Just real. Story #2: A client win. One problem. One change. One believable result. No hype. Just proof. Story #3: Your vision. Where you’re taking people. What you believe is the better way. Cycle these stories through your content. Origin builds trust. Client wins build proof. Vision builds authority. That’s how people stop scrolling… And start wanting to work with you. 🧠 Build a business that brings in leads on autopilot. Get my free course in the link in bio. #marketingtips #contentstrategy #storytelling #brandtrust #onlinebusiness #digitalmarketing #creatorstrategy #authoritybuilding #leadgeneration
transcript: Do you want to build trust fast without sounding salesy? Well, use this three part story system across all of your content. It's called the storytelling flywheel and here's how to use it. Part 1, your origin story. This is the why. Why do you do what you do? Don't try to impress anyone here. Just be real. For example, I built my first system out of frustration. Leads were slipping through the cracks and I was burnt out. I didn't start this because I had it figured out. I started it because I had to. Whatever you do here, keep it simple because this builds connection. Part 2, a client win story. Pick a real situation. What problem did they have? What changed? And what was the result? For example, my client was posting every day with no leads. We changed the captions and CTA and she booked three calls that week. The key here is to focus on small, believable results. You don't want to exaggerate. Just show what's possible. Part 3, your vision story. This one shows your direction. Where are you taking your clients? What do you believe is the better way? For example, I believe business owners shouldn't need to hustle 24 7. The future is automation, simple systems and smarter marketing. That, my friend, is leadership and that's what creates buying. The key here though, is to cycle through these stories across your content. Origin builds trust, client stories build proof and vision builds Authority. This is how you become someone that people want to work with.
